description: Fetch nutrient profiles for several foods at once. More efficient than calling usda_get_food N times when you already have multiple FDC IDs. Accepts up to 500 IDs: repeats are dropped, the first 20 distinct IDs are fetched, and the rest are returned in deferredIds for a follow-up call. IDs FDC does not return before the call's deadline (slow Foundation records, most often) or keeps failing on also come back in deferredIds, ahead of those, named in a notice. Values are per 100 of each food's basisUnit, with no portion scaling: per 100 g (basisUnit "g"), except Branded foods FDC reports per 100 ml (basisUnit "ml") or per 100 of a label unit that fixes neither (basisUnit absent, basis unverified). Use the nutrients[] filter to limit response size — strongly recommended for batch calls; requested IDs a food does not report are listed in its missingNutrients. Set provenance=true to add to each nutrient how FDC obtained its value (derivation code, description, and source), its sample count (dataPoints), and the sample min, max, and median, each only where FDC sends it. For side-by-side comparison with a formatted table, use usda_compare_foods instead. Failed IDs (not found or no data) are reported in the failed[] array rather than aborting the entire batch.

fdcIds.description: FDC IDs to fetch — 2 to 500 entries (a server configured with strict limits rejects more than 20). Repeats are dropped; the first 20 distinct IDs are fetched and the rest are returned in deferredIds. Use usda_search_foods to discover IDs.

nutrients.description: Filter to specific nutrient IDs (e.g. [1003, 1004, 1005, 1008]). Strongly recommended — full profiles can be large. Use usda_list_nutrients to look up IDs. Requested IDs a food does not report are listed in its missingNutrients.

provenance.description: Add to each nutrient what FDC records about its value: derivation (code, description, source), dataPoints (sample count), and min, max, median (sample spread, per 100 of basisUnit like amount). Each is present only where FDC sends it: Survey (FNDDS) foods send none, Branded foods only a derivation. Off by default; it makes the response two to three times as large.

name: usda_get_foods

deferredIds.description: Distinct requested IDs this call did not fetch, in request order: any FDC did not return before the call's deadline or kept failing on, then those past the first 20, which were never requested from FDC. foods and failed cover neither. Pass them to usda_get_foods again, or a single one to usda_get_food, with the same nutrients and provenance. Absent when every distinct ID was fetched.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `retry_deadline_exceeded`: FDC did not answer within the call's 45-second budget, across every attempt. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: IDs that returned no data. Check these with usda_search_foods to verify they exist.

items.description: A failed food fetch with the FDC ID and error reason.

error.description: Why this ID failed — not found, no data returned, etc.

fdcId.description: FDC ID that could not be fetched.

basisUnit.description: What the per-100 nutrient values are measured in: "g" for every non-Branded food and for Branded labels in g/GRM/GM, "ml" for Branded labels in ml/MLT. Absent when the label unit (e.g. IU, MG) fixes neither, so the basis is unverified.

dataType.description: FDC data source: SR Legacy, Foundation, Survey (FNDDS), or Branded.

description.description: Full USDA food name (e.g. "Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, raw").

missingNutrients.description: Requested nutrient IDs this food's profile does not report, deduplicated, in request order. Absent when nutrients[] was omitted or every requested ID is present.

items.description: A nutrient entry with ID, name, amount, and unit.

dataPoints.description: Number of samples behind the value, as FDC sends it; with provenance=true only. SR Legacy sends it on every value (0 for calculated and assumed values), Foundation on analytical values; Branded and Survey (FNDDS) send none. A count, never scaled.

derivation.description: How FDC obtained the value; with provenance=true only. Foundation and Branded send one on every value, SR Legacy on some (a measured SR Legacy value can carry only dataPoints), Survey (FNDDS) on none. Absent when FDC sends none, never inferred. Code "Z" is an assumed zero, not a measurement.

description.description: What the code means, as FDC words it (e.g. "Analytical", "Calculated", "Summed").

source.description: Source category FDC files the derivation under (e.g. "Analytical or derived from analytical", "Calculated or imputed", "Assumed zero"). Absent when FDC sends none.

max.description: Highest sample value, in the same unit and basis as amount and scaled with it; with provenance=true only. Foundation sends it on most values, SR Legacy on some; Branded and Survey (FNDDS) send none.

median.description: Median sample value, in the same unit and basis as amount and scaled with it; with provenance=true only. Foundation sends it on most values; SR Legacy, Branded, and Survey (FNDDS) send none.

min.description: Lowest sample value, in the same unit and basis as amount and scaled with it; with provenance=true only. Foundation sends it on most values, SR Legacy on some; Branded and Survey (FNDDS) send none.

servingSizeUnit.description: Label serving unit as FDC reports it (e.g. "GRM", "MLT", "IU"); it sets basisUnit. Branded items only.

notice.description: Deferral notice when deferredIds is present: how many of the distinct IDs past the first 20 were not fetched, which fetched IDs FDC did not return before the deadline or kept failing on, and the call that fetches them.

title: Get USDA Foods (Batch)
